about_the_game:
Throne Alone is a rage-flavored platformer in the spirit of Getting Over It, Jump King, and Alt+F4 - but with a few forgiving twists. Scattered (yet scarce) checkpoints let you celebrate progress with showers of confetti before the desert humbles you again. Expect sweaty palms, shattered pride, and the occasional moment of zen as you master porcelain-based parkour.

Physics Is the Final Boss

Every pivot, bounce, and face-plant is driven by a realistic physics system that turns a simple toilet into a deadly juggling act.

Sparse - but Merciful - Checkpoints

Nail a Royal Flush Beacon, watch the sky explode in confetti, exhale. Then steel yourself for the next punishment.

Hand-Crafted Rage Fuel

No procedural cheats: every ramp, spike, and launchpad is placed for maximum “one more try” agony and eventual euphoria.

The AI That Loves Your Pain

A sardonic artificial overseer delivers real-time commentary: mocking failures, praising stylish saves, and leaking cryptic lore about why this “toilet pilgrimage” matters.

Lore You Didn’t Ask For

You may unlock the details about your purpose. Or you don't.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 • AMD FX-6300
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD HD 7850 / Intel UHD 620 (2 GB VRAM, DirectX 11)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 • AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4 GB VRAM, DirectX 12)

short_description: Not your average toilet sim. Drag and yeet a resilient porcelain bowl through a merciless desert of spring-loaded traps, floating rocks and other inexplicable nonsense. Brutal physics, humiliating setbacks, and glorious confetti pay-offs.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
